about: Every LLM log store on this Mac: where it lives, who writes it, who cleans it and by what criterion. Measured daily by `bin/system-doctor logstores`, cleaned by `bin/log-sweep` (cleaner `sweep`). Registering a store is adding an entry here; writers are never constrained. cleaner: self = the writer prunes it, sweep = bin/log-sweep, cap = the app caps it, keep = never deleted, measured only. Criterion (at most one): days (a unit untouched that long: a file by its mtime, a directory by the newest mtime inside it), max_mb (the newest units within that many MB), keep_newest (that many newest units), tail_mb (a file truncated to its last N MB). One glob match is one unit; "type": "file" keeps files only.
